question: Does provisional per-cell LC10a input separate frontal/lateral and inward/outward AOTU responses?

protocol.fly: fixed at x=z=heading=0; no feedback or movement
protocol.motion: 400 ms pulse: static or 10 degree azimuth sweep at 25 deg/s; outward and inward visit the same angles in reverse order
protocol.matched_current: Override bearing-amplitude envelope with full current inside the original view gate; isolate anatomical distribution at equal total input.
protocol.playable_envelope: Use the existing bearing-amplitude envelope, still with a fixed fly.
protocol.conditions: uniform, anatomy, 12 within-side LC10a output-bundle shuffles; uniform shuffle must equal uniform intact.
protocol.AOTU_spikes: Counts from one recorded AOTU019 or AOTU025 cell on the stimulated side, per 400 ms pulse; modeled spikes, not measured firing.
protocol.DNa02_toward_bias_mv: Mean DNa02 voltage difference signed toward the target side; positive requests a turn toward the target under the engineered decoder.
